name: AmberX lists help
description: Help mode entries for the AmberX lists plugin (help@1): the page, its controls and its settings tab.
author: Brett

entries.title: AmberX lists
entries.text: Every AmberX list on every device. Pick one to see what is in it; tick items off, edit or delete them, add new ones. Claude reaches the same lists with amberx-lists_* and control_*, the CLI with axf list.

entries.title: Every list
entries.text: The list tree with how many items each holds. Make a list here: it goes inside the list picked, or at the top.

entries.title: One list
entries.text: Rename it, move it inside another list, export it as Markdown (copied), or delete it with everything in it (asks first; Inbox, Plugins and Voice notes can't be deleted).

entries.title: AmberX lists settings
entries.text: Whether new list items are to-dos (they can be ticked) or notes, whether ticked items show and go last, and whether empty lists show. Kept on the console: axf amberx-lists set-settings changes them too.

entries.title: Open a list
entries.text: Opens the lists page on one list (its id) or the new list field (new).
